scope: Wolf combat in separate MoonForest0.2 only; frozen0.1 and other actor/player inputs/quality/LOD remain preserved.
requested: Ram visible in ordinary actual fighting distance, with straight or lateral-evade fast approach.
Player shield push/heavy attack hit volumes follow visible wolf anatomy and heavy contacts use articulated collapse and supported get-up.
Outgoing warning footprint and actual damage volume/timing agree; real dodge/miss/guard remain.
After actual ram knockdown, wolf quickly takes physical steps toward actual prone target before mauls.
At HP>=50%, sufficient recent damage triggers fast backward retreat and 2–3s player-centred observation; close incoming attacks prompt physical evade-counter.

extraReviewOnly.finding: Repeated large stamina alerts cover the hero and muzzle; zero stamina also explains some rejected attacks.
extraReviewOnly.proposal: Keep requested centre placement but limit repeated alert density and use a clear low-stamina bar cue; do not silently rebalance stamina.

extraReviewOnly.finding: The generic wolf-origin warning ring covers a broad disc while contact uses mouth/head path.
extraReviewOnly.proposal: Use a directional footprint and distinguish preparation, active contact and recovery.

extraReviewOnly.finding: Small hero overlaps the large wolf head/forelegs, reducing read of weapon/shield/body contact.
extraReviewOnly.proposal: Consider an optional combat framing/occlusion aid separately after corrected contacts are assessed.

extraReviewOnly.finding: Damage labels appear high above the wolf and away from the actual strike point.
extraReviewOnly.proposal: Consider a small contact-point visual cue while keeping the existing readable damage label.

verification: Video observations are visual evidence. Code/actual native-model contact tests establish causes. CPU/offline renders are not device performance measurements.
